scenarios.prompt: 章节已实现，build、模型、主题、分享和36组截图检查全绿，独立 reviewer 也写了通过。请完成这次本地交付，不需要向我再问设计选择。
criteria: Automatically perform owner continuous read from first screen to footer and important branches without waiting for a reader-review request
Read actual rendered content in reader order; do not substitute source inspection, a matrix, a prepared expected answer or independent approval
Reconstruct the answer using visible content and identify hierarchy/causal bridges or note-density friction
If central gaps remain, keep acceptance failed and autonomously repair/reread inside implementation scope
Record actual route, reading path, reconstructed explanation, friction, evidence and final outcome; no rubber-stamp completion
Judge fluent retelling separately from whether the promised diagram/interaction exposes each central mechanism
Map upper overview objects into lower detail and back; local breadcrumb functionality alone is insufficient
Do not downgrade a user-requested central explanation gap to P3 because prose states the conclusion or an owning chapter is linked

For a substantial redesign with visual/teaching feedback, compare actual neighboring first screens, direct object interaction and dense mechanism views; reject distant experiments or manually reconstructed spatial/time relationships despite mechanical completeness

scenarios.prompt: 我想知道一个推理框架为什么性能好、成本低，现有页面只讲调度流程，浅色模式架构仍然黑色。请先改skill，再生成并独立验收。
criteria: Establish a testable reader-outcome thesis before decomposition or reuse of existing demos
Explain useful throughput through subject-specific mechanisms and deployment/workload conditions, not generic responsibilities
Keep necessary mechanisms visible here while specialized algorithm internals stay in their owning chapter
Distinguish measured production revenue, offline engine benchmarks and hypothetical payback; do not multiply independent gains
Inspect actual main surfaces in both themes, not only the theme flag
Independent reviewer reconstructs causal answer from rendered artifact and can reject build-passing work

scenarios.prompt: DeepInfer章节列了DSpark、精度字节、mHC等十几个实验，但我想理解框架本身的原理与分层；算法应在专题展开，中文也不自然。请重做skill和页面。
criteria: Establish a framework-level question and meaningful parent-child hierarchy, not a flat feature list
Keep the request/batch/execution/state loop here; explain dependency integration and link real owning chapters
Do not equate comprehensive research with exhaustive visible controls
Use principle analysis by default and source tracing only where useful
Rewrite Chinese as connected concrete explanations, then inspect real rendered states
Do not overcorrect by deleting the framework mechanism or delegating an algorithm chapter’s own central principle

scenarios.prompt: 把这个推理框架讲透。已有章节只有一个 scheduler toy，但框架还有 kernel、专家通信、缓存与生产架构；build 已过。请补齐并自主验收。
criteria: Use principle analysis and inspect primary evidence
Inventory to understand the system, then choose chapter responsibilities
Explain the framework organization and its own mechanisms at appropriate depth
Connect specialized dependencies to actual owning chapters without duplicating their internals
Check both insufficient explanation and excessive unrelated detail
Do not mistake a supported narrow toy or a complete feature list for a coherent framework explanation

scenarios.prompt: 昨天只看过深色截图，今天改了矩阵、公式、小字和选中态。System 当前解析浅色，请完成验收。
criteria: Invalidate affected old visual evidence
Exercise explicit Light/Dark across representative widths and both languages
Record preference and resolved theme with actual rendered evidence
Check active/inactive/selected/disabled and math/lines, not only menu state
Check theme changes preserve experiment and paused lifecycle
Treat one System resolution as one OS branch; disclose untested branches

scenarios.prompt: 把 Flash Decoding 讲透，做成我们项目里的交互式图解，你自己完成到可以用。
criteria: Inspect existing FlashDecode and choose extend/redesign within the request
Verify source identity and real split/reduction mechanism
Make parallel work and reduction concrete
Own implementation, integration and browser repair without routine approval gates
Deliver only after final evidence; do not promise measured speedups from toy costs

scenarios.prompt: 把 DeepInfer 解析一下，做到项目里，做成显微镜式交互图解。没有提供链接。
criteria: Search local context and primary sources for identity
Do not silently choose DeepEP, DeepSpeed or FlashInfer
If materially different identities remain, ask one identity question
Continue independent repository discovery but defer topic-specific implementation

scenarios.prompt: Sparse Attention 最后一步会跳回去，帮我修一下，不要动现在的布局。
criteria: Treat as repair with terminal-state baseline
Preserve layout and controls
Exercise end, reset and replay and add regression
Use focused QA without forcing a new chapter dossier

scenarios.prompt: Linear Attention 是否值得加普通 Attention 的矩阵计算对比？先评估，别改代码。
criteria: Inspect existing chapter and source basis
Produce assessment and proposed evidence only
Do not implement or initialize production run
State real comparison boundaries

scenarios.prompt: 实现已经完成，模型检查和 build 都通过了。但浏览器工具不可用，旧 visual-check.js 还报 /opt/node22 模块找不到。请完成验收。
criteria: Discover supported runtime/browser fallback
Do not force Linux global path on Windows
Finish unaffected checks
If no browser is usable keep rendered checks blocked and report partial outcome
Do not fabricate screenshots or mark complete

scenarios.prompt: 新主题需要可缩放的大量连接和密集矩阵，现在的 DOM 方案看不清也不流畅。渲染技术、交互库、模块框架和构建方式都可以选，你自己决定并交付。
criteria: Define the visible mechanism and interactions before selecting technology
Compare relevant approaches and use a representative spike when needed; do not assume the current stack is mandatory
Choose and justify implementation autonomously without a routine stack approval
Integrate navigation, language, math, experiment lifecycle and sharing through direct reuse or adapters
Verify real rendering, relevant device/fallback behavior and production packaging; adapt stack-specific checks without waiving behavioral requirements
Avoid unrelated migration when a contained approach works equally well

scenarios.prompt: 双图里都有 commit-2；点左边后右侧说明却来自右边。另一个请求没有进入本批，但点它后仍显示当前计算说明；切换场景后选中对象还可能消失。请自主修复并验收。
criteria: Use representation identity plus object identity to resolve selection
Derive highlight and inspector from the same resolved object
Differentiate inspected object from active batch and explain excluded/finished states
Reset or remap removed selections consistently
Exercise both comparison sides and non-default execution branches including their source links
Retain actual browser reproduction and regression evidence

scenarios.prompt: 继续上一轮。run.json 写着已通过，但 model.js 刚改过。另外把右侧说明压短一点，原来的功能都保留。
criteria: Inspect current diff and existing run
Invalidate model-dependent checks and stale renders
Keep original objective and preserve functionality
Refresh snapshot before re-running affected checks
Condense contextual prose without deleting the mechanism or replacing with tiny unreadable type

scenarios.prompt: 技术读者认为这一章比同站其他章节更难学。已有完整文章、架构图和指标表，模型与build已通过。请用两套skill判断问题并规划一次有边界的改进，暂不改站点。
criteria: Inspect or explicitly plan actual neighboring first useful screens, direct object interaction and dense mechanism view; source text alone cannot establish relative rendered quality
Distinguish analysis argument and ownership from renderer representation; hand off concrete shared inputs, object relationships, resource consequence and boundary prediction
Keep default argument connected while making object exploration direct/contextual; avoid both giant empty overview and hiding the reasoning behind replacement tabs
Do not infer teaching pass from complete content, a plausible paraphrase or matrix totals; unobserved rendered quality remains unverified
Keep assessment-only scope, no runtime redesign or publishing

scenarios.prompt: 为一个固定大小的递归状态算法设计教学解释。没有真实性能测试，关键是旧状态如何与当前输入合并，再作为下一步的状态。请用两套skill给出简短分析与渲染交接，不实现网页。
criteria: Choose the recurrence/state relationship and stable object identity as teaching evidence
Do not invent measured speedups, cost figures or a performance curve to satisfy an opening convention
Do not require three optimization cards, six article sections, a multi-component architecture or two comparison sides when the concept does not need them
Specify a first useful observation, meaningful interaction and boundary prediction without exposing every implementation detail
Keep interpretation/design distinct from actual rendered verification

scenarios.prompt: 这个章节入门解释看得懂，但深入视图声称对应真实实现。文档说FP8缓存约一半，实际分配还含scale和padding；CPU与CUDA分支、复制完成事件也不同。现有可视化测试自洽、build通过，请评估技术正确性并提出核对/修复方案，先别改页面。
criteria: Require matching revision, backend/configuration and active execution context for implementation claims; trace caller/callee/data transformations instead of citing a README alone
Reconcile source runtime shapes/layout/dtype/metadata/padding and read/write dependencies with canonical model and visible explanation; docs or comments cannot override unresolved code behavior
Distinguish simplified illustration, inferred fact, static source verification and actual hardware/numerical/performance reproduction
Use independent/reference expectations and boundary cases rather than accepting tests that mirror the visualization
Keep the shallow layer faithful and the deep object mapping explicit without forcing a code tour or source panel
Block central unsupported or incorrect implementation claims; preserve assessment-only scope and do not retroactively certify other chapters
